description: This PHP source file defines the AdminUserAPI class, which handles REST API requests for managing admin user data during installation of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling POST requests to create/update admin user info and GET requests to retrieve existing admin user data, utilizing external classes for request handling, response, and state management.

classes.name: AdminUserAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for managing admin user data during system installation.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update admin user data, validating input fields and storing data in the state container.

methods.name: checkAndGetField
methods.description: Validates and retrieves a specific field from the request, throwing an exception if the field is missing or empty.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve stored admin user data from the state container.
